001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.pojo;
002
003import androidx.room.Relation;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
005import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
006import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
007import java.util.List;
008
009/**
010 * The {@code UserWithContent} class is an extension of the {@code User} class
011 * that incorporates additional related content, such as {@code Pin} and
012 * {@code TrackWithPins} entities associated with a user.
013 *
014 * It includes relationships to other entities:
015 * - {@code pins}: Represents a list of {@code Pin} objects associated with the user,
016 *   linked by the "user_id" field.
017 * - {@code tracks}: Represents a list of {@code TrackWithPins} objects associated
018 *   with the user, also linked by the "user_id" field.
019 *
020 * This class is typically used for scenarios where additional content or relationships
021 * related to the user need to be retrieved or processed.
022 */
023public class UserWithContent extends User {
024
025  @Relation(parentColumn = "user_id", entityColumn = "user_id")
026  private List<Pin> pins;
027  @Relation(entity = Track.class, parentColumn = "user_id", entityColumn = "user_id")
028  private List<TrackWithPins> tracks;
029
030  public List<Pin> getPins() {
031    return pins;
032  }
033
034  public void setPins(List<Pin> pins) {
035    this.pins = pins;
036  }
037
038  public List<TrackWithPins> getTracks() {
039    return tracks;
040  }
041
042  public void setTracks(List<TrackWithPins> tracks) {
043    this.tracks = tracks;
044  }
045
046}
